notice_board.name: Greyfen Notice Board
notice_board.greeting: A rain-stiff contract hangs beneath a rusted nail. A prayer charm has been pressed into the wood beside it.
lines: Missing: Bram Kett, Sella Vey, and Oren Vey. Their cart returned empty from the old road.
Black feathers were found in the blood. Sister Anwen keeps the names and pays for proof.

sister_anwen.name: Sister Anwen
sister_anwen.greeting: You came about the road notice.
lines: Bram drove. Sella walked beside him. Oren was her son. He was twelve.
If you find black feathers tied in red thread, leave them intact. The thread came from this shrine.
Kael: You knew that before the contract was posted.
Sister Anwen: Yes. Bring me what the road left, and I will tell you why.

variants.greeting: The bell rope was cut last winter. It still rang three times after your report.
lines: Sister Anwen: Once means burial. Twice means a name restored.
Kael: And three?
Sister Anwen: I do not know. That is the first clean answer I have given you. Check the disturbed graves.

variants.greeting: Anwen knows Oren's token before Kael opens his hand.
lines: Kael: You know it.
Anwen: I know the carving.
Kael: That is not what I said.
Anwen: No. Oren was not the first child given that token.

variants.greeting: The token is already pinned beneath the contract. Anwen does not look at it.
lines: Anwen: You gave Greyfen the truth before giving it time to choose courage.
Kael: Courage chosen after warning is only obedience.
Anwen: Then we will learn what fear chooses.
Anwen: You found something.
Kael: I found reasons to keep looking.
Anwen: Keep them close. Greyfen has practiced taking things from the dead.

mira.name: Mira Fen
mira.greeting: Keep the door open. People trust medicine less when the healer whispers.
lines: I can dress a wound and tell you what poisoned it.
I cannot make Greyfen honest about either.

variants.greeting: The core is quieter in grave cloth. Not silent.
lines: Mira: I asked it for a name. It gave me the smell of wet wheat.
Kael: That was not permission to keep asking.
Mira: No. It was a reason.

variants.greeting: The roots turned when I said Oren's name. Not toward me. Toward the old stones.
lines: Mira: I tested names on plants grown in grave soil. I told myself medicine made the knowing useful.
Kael: Useful is not clean.
Mira: No. Read the chapel register. Then speak Oren's name where the road turns wet.

actions.label: I will read the chapel register.

variants.greeting: The roots turned when I said Oren's name. Not toward me. Toward the old stones.
lines: Mira: I tested names on plants grown in grave soil. I told myself medicine made the knowing useful.
Kael: Useful is not clean.
Mira: No. Read the chapel register. Take Moon Oil if you want the thing beneath those stones to show what it remembers.

actions.label: I will read the chapel register.
Give me what Moon Oil needs.
Keep the truth between us.
actions.result: Mira keeps working, but no longer meets your eyes.

actions.label: Greyfen deserves the truth.
actions.result: Mira agrees to name what feeds the roots.

edric.name: Lord Edric Vargan
edric.greeting: My family paid for Greyfen's walls. Remember that before you spit at my boots.
lines: Yes, the signet is Vargan work. No, I did not spill that blood.
The ruins still keep our records. If guilt has a shape, you will find it under stone.

rook.name: Rook
rook.greeting: You want the old road? Watch the crows, not the mud.
lines: It bends twice where it should run straight. I checked. Then I decided I preferred being alive.
A boy found black feathers under his pillow after the second death. His mother burned the whole bed.

widow_elna.name: Widow Elna
widow_elna.greeting: The bell rings at dusk. My Harl is dead, but he still calls.
lines: Find why the cemetery bell rings. Bring me cruelty or kindness, but bring me an answer.

actions.label: He was calling for a witness.
actions.result: Elna rings the bell once, then cuts its cord.

blacksmith_tor.name: Blacksmith Tor
blacksmith_tor.greeting: Let me see the blade. No, keep hold of it. I trust the steel.
lines: If you mean to trap whatever is out there, take scrap. Better the iron snaps than your leg.
I heard the cemetery bell last night. The rope has been cut since winter.

farmer_toma.name: Farmer Toma
farmer_toma.greeting: It took three sheep and one child screaming before anyone believed me.
lines: Nobody speaks near the shrine after dusk. Not since Anwen washed blood from the altar stones.
They say a black dog is killing stock. I say no dog opens a latch and leaves boot prints.
Find what hunts the fold. Bring proof, not village gossip.

actions.label: The guardian protected the children.
actions.result: Toma looks toward the fold and lowers his knife.

white_hart.name: The White Hart
white_hart.greeting: You walk on promises buried under your kind's roads.
lines: Kill me, and the village breathes while the wood turns to ash.
Free me, and truth will have teeth.
Bind me, and you inherit the old sin.
Expose them, and let human hands answer human crimes.
